  "required_fixes": [
    "C22-R3-F1 (high): Save an interrupted turn's unsaved transcript even when none of its entries is currently Streaming. crates/desktop-core/src/harness/session.rs:564-568 still gates the entire stop-time save on any Streaming entry. Send creates only a Complete operator entry (:1164-1178); MCP item completion replaces its Streaming entry with Complete/Failed (:1519-1523, :1639-1649); an assistant Streaming entry is created only when an agentMessage actually starts (:1692-1708). Therefore an approved MCP call can finish, with its result/trace visible, while the engine waits for the next Gateway response and the turn is still active. Sleep/quit/end in that window makes cut false: no save occurs and no save failure is reported. On the first turn the whole record is lost; with earlier saved turns the record silently omits this call and its outcome. The null-export remediation correctly handles the running-call case but does not fix this outer condition. Detect an active/unsaved turn independently of entry display states and preserve its transcript without changing already-established call outcomes or inventing replay. Acceptance: finish an actual approved MCP call, hold the subsequent model response before any assistant item starts, verify no entries are Streaming, then stop and relaunch offline. The call's result/trace and known outcome must remain readable; reconnect must not replay it. Cover both a first turn with no export (notRestorable) and a conversation with earlier saved history."
  ],
  "blockers": [],
  "evidence_gaps": [
    "C22-R3-G1: Both real-engine interrupted-call tests stop during a deliberately delayed tools/call, while its entry is Streaming; the added refused-export test similarly creates a Streaming assistant entry. None exercises the post-tool-completion, pre-model-answer window in C22-R3-F1. Add source-bound production-interface evidence for that window, including offline inspection and no replay. The previous no-export test gap itself is closed."
  ],
  "optional_suggestions": [],
  "limitations": [
    "Read-only independent review: no source changes, test/build reruns, application/engine launches, product endpoint calls or credential access. The remaining finding follows the production state transitions and save predicate, corroborated by the synthetic Gateway's tool-call/result sequencing; it is not a newly executed runtime reproduction. Only the designated verdict artifact is written.",
    "All four supplied fingerprints independently match at the beginning and end. Verified the 689-entry source inventory, 388 referenced hashes, run logs/artifacts, shared input/scratch/installed equivalence and authentic passing C21 attempt-03 predecessor. Compared all eleven changed source inputs against attempt-02 and the base-commit diff; no dependency or build-flag change occurred.",
    "The previous missing-export branch is repaired: stop-time saving accepts no export, seals null context/replay, and native not_continuable rejects it as notRestorable before resume; the contract and history presentation recognize the reason. The real-engine first-turn test establishes offline retention and rejected continuation/no replay; the stand-in refused-export test covers the other absent-export branch. The optional OAuth race suggestion is also addressed with an observed token-request counter and revocation of the specific late-issued refresh token. The remaining issue is the enclosing Streaming-only save predicate.",
    "Recorded check/test/native-prepare commands pass. Evidence reports 408 frontend tests, 211 core unit tests, 15 workspace_mcp tests, 4 browser callback tests, 10 Harness tool tests, 12 IPC tests and 22 identity/history tests; targeted frontend/Harness unit runs overlap these totals. Thirty C22 mutations report their intended guards failing, and four baseline targets pass three times each; mutation input hashes match current source. The disclosed earlier C21 test timing failure was followed by a bounded Busy-only retry in that test, without a product behavior change.",
    "Seven current C22 native checks and workload measurements bind executable aa8a8dc9d9908bcedb84440aefcc2b0b79f9ee3967aa7244e5caae2187107f79. Recorded catalog/auth, per-call decisions/results, MCP-only rotation, expiry, scope retirement and keyboard activation pass. Recomputed nearest-rank p95 values fit unchanged registered limits: catalog 9.29 ms, ready 828.90 ms, approval 150.77 ms, answer 124.19 ms, rotation 350.97 ms; peak process-tree RSS is 423.7 MiB. Earlier copied native records are historical, not current-byte cumulative P06 acceptance.",
    "Earlier F1-F5, combined Gateway/MCP rotation and distinct execution-trace correlation remain supported on the integrated tree. OAuth/MCP/Gateway/model/browser services are synthetic; offline and sleep use fixture controls/elapsed time rather than hardware network removal or real sleep. Spoken VoiceOver, live provider behavior and signed installed-package qualification remain later gates. This is a C22 verdict, not P06 or release acceptance."
  ],
